title: Abortable Delay
prompt: Write `abortableDelay(ms, signal)` returning a promise that resolves with `"done"` after `ms` — UNLESS `signal` aborts first, in which case it must REJECT with an error whose `name` is `"AbortError"`. If the signal is already aborted, reject immediately.

tests.name: resolves when not aborted
tests.hint: setTimeout(() => resolve('done'), ms) — wire signal.addEventListener('abort', reject).

tests.name: rejects with AbortError when aborted mid-flight
tests.hint: The abort listener calls a reject function captured from the promise executor.

tests.name: already-aborted signal rejects immediately
tests.hint: Check signal?.aborted at the top and reject synchronously in that path.
